neighbours.label: The second part of a fixed noun-noun or noun-participle compound (-mounted, -linked, -routing, Art Director); the same content without the compound stays quiet
fire: The disease is an X-linked disorder in boys.
The wall-mounted heater warms the room.
Helmet-mounted cameras are popular with riders.
This is an onion-routing service for journalists.
The Art Director chose the colours for the film.
She became Art Director of the magazine in 2010.
A gender-linked pattern was found in the data.
quiet: The disease is a rare disorder in boys.
The heater on the wall warms the room.
Cameras on helmets are popular with riders.
This is a secure service for journalists.
The Managing Director chose the colours for the film.
She became Editor of the magazine in 2010.
A strange pattern was found in the data.
Panels on the roof supply the house.

short: second part of a compound (-mounted, Art Director)
notes: Card: '-linked' x3, 'ing' x2, 'inging' x2, ' Knights', ' Director' after Art, '-routing', '-mounted'. Probe: Art Director 0.88, Nam Knights 0.72, -mounted 0.63, -routing 0.48, -linked 0.30; Managing Director 0.05, 'mounted on the chest' 0.15, plain 'linked list' 0.01. Managing Director staying quiet means this is not simply any title.
